metadata.case_name: MAN LAI MUI v. DIRECTOR OF TERRITORY DEVELOPMENT AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fracture of the right neck of femur
source: sustained a fracture of the right neck of femur.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of neck of femur, unspecified

injuries.description: progressive wear of the cartilage of the hip due to pressure of the metal prosthesis following Austin Moore arthroplasty
source: consequent significant residual pain and stiffness of the hip joint due to progressive wear of the cartilage from pressure of the metal prosthesis.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: significant residual pain and stiffness of the hip joint
difficulty in activities of daily living and ambulation
required a full time domestic helper to relieve the burden on the Daughter
a walking frame for walking at home
would not require further therapeutic treatment except analgesics for her right hip pain
problem to progress in future due to progressive wear of the cartilage

treatments_received: Austin Moore arthroplasty (ie removal of the femoral head and replacing it with a metal prosthesis)

losses.description: The Plaintiff had difficulty in activities of daily living and ambulation and could not climb stairs; required a walking frame for walking at home.
The Plaintiff required a full time domestic helper to relieve the burden on the Daughter.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: The Plaintiff had difficulty in activities of daily living and required assistance for domestic tasks.
